api.exception_boundary: Exception becomes a safe PhaseCompletionResult; BaseException is not caught
api.side_effect: Only one O_EXCL initial-handoff.json or final-completion.json publication after every check passes

implementation.bridge_reads: Loads the source-bound Bridge once and invokes only read_public_result, read_dev_result, and read_solution(research.md). It checks bridge context rights, exact view hashes, native usage checkpoint hash/size/totals, and recomputes decide_phase against the actual typed latest outcome.
implementation.final_lineage: Continuation reopens the canonical bridge-state FinalArtifactLock, requires exact canonical bytes and TrustedIo equality, checks the five deployment scientific identities available at the Bridge boundary, and binds all 12 lock fields without hidden scoring.
implementation.native_gate: Requires a pre-existing contiguous <=40 v2 gate history, no active .gate-evaluation.lock, and >=1 latest record. Reuses phase_gate._read_gate_history, then reopens the exact maximum-sequence record by identity/hash. It never calls evaluate_gate_config or creates readiness evidence.
implementation.publication: Initial emits exactly the existing 13-field argo-house-price-a2-handoff/v1 with sorted two dev UUIDs. Continuation emits the exact argo-house-price-a2-final-completion/v1 fields, sorted two-or-three dev UUIDs, native gate FileBinding, current/prior sessions, canonical lock, combined usage, and hidden_score_observed=false. Full writes/fsync/reopen are bounded; existing or partial files are never overwritten or converted into a fabricated binding.
implementation.root_isolation: Completion directory is precreated mode0700 with exact device/inode and is disjoint from artifact/session/source/profile/gate-outcome roots.
implementation.sessions: Reopens the exact current native UUID.jsonl child of both configured and receipt session_dir. campaign_usage requires complete response-ID-bearing all-four-category usage. Continuation reopens the gate-bound prior session and combine_usage rejects duplicate session/response IDs. Unknown and >=120000 cannot publish.
implementation.terminal_process: Reopens the root FileBinding, parses exact RunControllerConfig without rerunning fresh-directory validation, validates deployment/frontend/process-exec identities, binds sealed frontend environment/session/cwd/model/phase/limits, reopens the actual process receipt through bridge._valid_prior_process_receipt, and crosschecks receipt handle/resource paths and limits against the process config.
